new_fulltext.title: Automatic Spectral Calibration of Hyperspectral Images: Method, Dataset and Benchmark
new_fulltext.depth: full main paper including references; supplement not obtained
new_fulltext.mechanism: Global illumination features modulate spectral attention; calibrated/uncalibrated HSI dataset.
new_fulltext.transfer: Illumination-conditioned input front-end and controlled illumination stress tests; distinguish radiance reconstruction from reflectance calibration.
new_fulltext.prior_art: SIT itself covers global illumination-aware spectral calibration; DivIll 2021 covers illumination variations; DIFIV 2023 covers cross-image spectral variability.
new_fulltext.kill_criteria: No calibrated target/measured illumination or no repeatable improvement over ordinary augmentation/simple global gains.

new_fulltext.title: Degradation-Robust Fusion: An Efficient Degradation-Aware Diffusion Framework for Multimodal Image Fusion in Arbitrary Degradation Scenarios
new_fulltext.depth: full main paper including references; supplement not obtained
new_fulltext.mechanism: Limited-step fused-output regression plus joint degradation/fusion observation correction.
new_fulltext.transfer: Deterministic supervised Net with optional bounded measurement-residual refinement; use actual HSI+MSI joint operator.
new_fulltext.prior_art: DRFusion, DDNM, PINO, NPN/GSNR already cover observation constraints or data-consistent priors.
new_fulltext.kill_criteria: Same-budget single/iterative gradient corrections or consistency loss perform equally; gains only in observation residual rather than HR spectral fidelity.
new_fulltext.formula_audit: Eq.15 proposed block generalized inverse is not a Moore–Penrose inverse for arbitrary rank-deficient operators; numerical counterexample recorded in literature-addendum.md. Product pseudoinverse reverse-order law also needs conditions. No code audit or experimental invalidation claimed.

new_fulltext.title: Real Noise Decoupling for Hyperspectral Image Denoising
new_fulltext.depth: full main paper including references; supplement not obtained
new_fulltext.mechanism: Synthetic calibrated-noise pretraining; frozen teacher to help learn unknown residual noise; wavelet guidance; joint finetuning.
new_fulltext.transfer: Small LR-HSI precleaning branch plus paired-noise fusion training; compare joint vs cascaded denoise/fusion with equal total budget.
new_fulltext.prior_art: RND directly covers explicit/implicit noise split and staged training; Hipandas covers joint denoise+guided HSI SR.
new_fulltext.kill_criteria: No real paired noise data, loss of weak spectral/edge details, or augmentation-only/cascaded baselines explain all improvement.
